source_scope_limitations.chronology: Episode-indexed responses are a selected fragment, not proof of complete chronological tournament coverage.
source_scope_limitations.known_card_selection: The 121-response source set includes only 78 known-card Ivey hands; this candidate subset is selected on known cards and source/replay validity. Treat results as development data, not representative performance evidence or a fresh holdout.

observations: Cached helper 27568.J sums source action amounts by actor, excluding antes from live commitment.

Cached helper 63221.d adds the current action amount to preceding same-round actor commitments; helper 63221.p subtracts all amounts at timestamp <= the current timestamp, so a time-only prefix can include the target action.

Cached helper 63221.O normalizes a flop round timestamp using the minimum card timestamp. The converter waits until the maximum of the three position-paired timestamps before exposing the full flop board, a conservative full-board cutoff.
